body:
The original-reference and quantity-grain qualification is now published in [Presto 0424](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/5e3a8c033df364d8b67aab352c4e8b2f92dc8ef7/experiments/2026-10-25_0424_codex_native-psmd2-source/README.md), following [0344 source recovery](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/5e3a8c033df364d8b67aab352c4e8b2f92dc8ef7/experiments/2026-10-25_0344_codex_proteasome-quantity-source/README.md). This is source evidence, not canonical admission, a fitted model or a completed release.

Key findings for the shared adapter:

- The exact deposited FASTA has **73,113 records**, not the article's stated reference count. The documented engineered reporter `P22222/NS3CCNB1_HUMAN` is tagged OX=9606, so taxonomy alone cannot establish endogenous eligibility. The deposited SHA1 verifies.
- Selective range retrieval recovered five original processed tables with local/central-header, size and CRC verification plus independent ZIP replay. Only 7,965,911 bytes of the 167,389,796-byte ZIP were retrieved; its full SHA1 is not claimed.
- The original table has **10,647 peptide rows and 80 fields**, with **40,679 evidence rows and 10,935 modification-specific rows**. All **74,529 publisher intensity cells** match original text exactly, and all native ID memberships and six run mappings reconcile.
- Raw and LFQ intensities differ in **30,170 cells**. Some **5,765 positive sequence/acquisition cells contain positive modified-feature evidence**. Keep quantity grains distinct. Feature/form sums have small nonzero residuals in some cells (maximum relative residuals 8.052e-5/7.550e-5); preserve supplied values and residuals instead of silently substituting sums or asserting an unproved rounding algorithm.
- The original text directly supplies the correct source annotations for all **13 date-corrupted gene cells** through matching sequence/native-ID records. This does not require guessing gene symbols from dates or rewriting the publisher workbook.
- Full-reference mapping yields **38,641 candidate spans**, including **403 I/L-only alternatives**. **6,809 peptides** have multiple distinct parent sequences; **582** have possible parent accessions omitted from the reported list; **53** have reporter origins. All 24 declared accession tokens absent from the FASTA are contaminant-prefixed.
- All-source parent dependencies produce **1,689 components** before selection. A descriptive complete-acquisition, strict-origin stratum has **82 parents / 81 components / 228 potential reference contrasts**. No reference peptide, split, numerical condition effect or model has been selected.

Independent closure reparses every FASTA record, verifies every span, replays all 10,647 dependency assignments with a separate graph algorithm, and checks all quantity/support summaries. The initial verifier-only EmptyCell failure and narrow successful recovery remain recorded.

Implementation is staged in a durable isolated feature checkout from main `436a72f`, with a detailed source/query specification. The next work remains the shared native-peptidomics adapter and metadata contracts, meaningful tests, independently replayed canonical package, versioned PR and tested release, followed by a separately registered biological contrast recipe. This issue remains open; professional-APC transfer and complete-pool concentration calibration are still separate unmet requirements.
